name: Neural field bars and bumps
description: Neural field found by the class-4 search: travelling bars (sheets of activity sliding sideways) coexisting with travelling bumps; bars shed bumps at their ends and absorb bumps that hit them. Things to try: the seed brush (drag a line for a new bar, tap for a bump); raise I slightly to make bars grow, lower it to break them into bumps; paint g to change speed locally.
